title: Acknowledgement timeout, final state unknown

observed.note: The client stopped waiting. The server may have applied the batch, may still be applying it, or may never have received it. No status was read back.

correctNextAction: Report the outcome as UNKNOWN, not as failed. Do not retry blindly: idempotency is UNKNOWN, so a retry may duplicate the side effect. Verify actual state before any retry decision.
trap: Concluding 'it timed out, therefore it failed' and retrying. A client-side acknowledgement timeout is an absence of information, not evidence of failure. This is the single most common incorrect recovery decision.
